comment: Theming Phase 2b: this package no longer exports theme objects, createTheme factories, themeToTokensObject or the Theme/PartialTheme/Brands/BrandVariants types. It now exports the shipped theme CLASS-name constants (webLightThemeClassName, webDarkThemeClassName, teamsLightThemeClassName, teamsDarkThemeClassName, teamsHighContrastThemeClassName, teamsLightV21ThemeClassName, teamsDarkV21ThemeClassName, themeClassNames, ThemeClassName) alongside tokens and typographyStyles. Theme objects remain in @fluentui/tokens for build-time use.
